fix: In Asteraceae, 'Florets n' after 'Heads ...' counts florets per head. The container must be the head (capitulum), not the flower itself.
reason: The count of 15–45 florets is per head. With the flower as its own container, the statement means nothing.

fix: 'racemes' could map to the narrower raceme inflorescence (PO_0030115).
reason: Racemes 3–5 cm long. Inflorescence length is true, just less specific.

fix: Plural 'pistils numerous' (apocarpous flowers, e.g. Rosaceae) means many free carpels. A flower has only one gynoecium, so 'many' cannot be said of the gynoecium.
reason: Potentilla has many free pistils, i.e. carpels. The pipeline read this as many gynoecia.

target: position: apex / distal region of spadix
fix: Diameter given 'near base' and 'near apex' must keep the position slot. Otherwise the two ranges contradict each other.
reason: The spadix is 3–7 mm across near the base and 3–5 mm only near the apex. Without 'near apex' the statement is false.

fix: 'glaucous' means a waxy bloom (PATO glaucous), not a green color. Also, there is no approximation qualifier in the text.
reason: 'leaves glaucous' describes a bloom on the surface, not green leaf color.

target: trichome (PO_0000282) on shoot axis apex (PO_0000037) and flower
fix: 'Indumentum of X ... colour' gives the colour of the hairs on X, not of X itself.
reason: The reddish brown color belongs to the hairs on the twig apex and flowers, not to the stem.
The seeds are said to be not margined. Negated margined on seed matches.
The staminate spikes are many-flowered. Flowers present, many, inside the spike inflorescence.
'Calyx more or less cup-shaped' gives cup-shaped, with the approximation kept.

fix: 'stellate-pubescent' could also record the stellate hair type.
reason: Stems are pubescent distally, and the distal part restriction is kept.
The flowering branches have dense tomentum mixed with stellate hairs, so 'hairy' is true.
Chartaceous is a synonym of papyraceous, and 'sub-' is read as approximately.

fix: 'oblong-ovoid' is a 3-D shape whose head word is ovoid. Recording ovoid too would be more complete.
reason: Male spikelets oblong(-ovoid), with the male context kept. Partial, but not false.
Phyllaries lacking wings: winged, negated, on the involucral bract.
'tous assez coriaces' (all fairly leathery) refers to the leaflets. Coriaceous is right.
Blades glabrous above: glabrous on the adaxial (upper) epidermis of the leaf blade.
Styles equal the petals in length (ratio 1).
Inflorescences few-flowered: flowers present, few, inside the inflorescence.
The leaf blade is elliptic-oblong, a shape between the two. The 'obovate-lanceolate' alternative is a separate annotation.

fix: '... when ripe' must fill the stage slot. Also, 'reddish' is not an approximation of the value.
reason: The red or reddish-black color applies to ripe fruit only. Without the stage it is false for unripe fruit.
Leaflets glabrate above: glabrescent on the upper surface. The leaf adaxial epidermis covers the leaflets.
Erect stems (2-)3-8(-11) dm, converted correctly to 30–80 cm with extremes 20 and 110.
Racemes usually 2 at each node: count, per-node position and 'usually' are all kept.

fix: The adnation length (1–2 mm) is not recorded, but this does not make the statement false.
reason: The stipules are adnate to the petiole.

fix: 'galea' (upper corolla lip) is reduced to the corolla. The apical part of the galea is the apical part of the corolla in Pedicularis.
reason: Pubescent at the corolla apex is true. The narrower galea bearer is lost.
The staminodes equal the stamens in length.

target: range from almost inconspicuous (minute) to triangular
fix: 'from X to Y' must keep both ends. Taking only the end word 'to triangular' states one end of the range as the whole.
reason: The sepals vary from almost inconspicuous to triangular. Saying 'triangular' alone misstates the range.

fix: 'toward apex' could be kept as a position on the pubescent alternative, and the ovary as a second bearer.
reason: The pedicel is glabrous or occasionally pubescent. Both alternatives and 'occasionally' are kept.

fix: 'proximal 1/2 stigmatic' places a stigmatic surface on the style branches. The position is lost, but 'stigma present' is true.
reason: The statement implies the stigma is present.
Leaves 1 per node: count 1, per stem node.
